name: note1
description: Search your meetings and get answers with cited sources. note1 turns recorded meetings into summaries, speaker-attributed transcripts and action items, and this plugin lets you work with them from a conversation: find what was decided, see who spoke and what was asked, export notes, list and complete action items together with their linked tickets in tools such as GitHub, Linear and Jira, set up topic trackers, check which calendar events are being recorded, schedule or cancel note1's recording bot, and upload an existing recording. Every action uses your own note1 permissions, so private meetings stay private.

interface.longDescription:
note1 is an AI meeting notetaker. It joins your calls, records them and writes up each meeting as a summary with action items. This plugin connects note1 to ChatGPT so you can work with that meeting data in a conversation.

Ask about your meetings
- Ask what was decided or discussed and get an answer with cited meeting titles, dates and timestamps.
- Search by keyword and meaning across summaries, transcripts, action items, topics and questions.
- See who spoke and for how long, which questions were asked and answered, and which topics came up.
- Read a meeting's summary, sections, participants and recurring series, or export the summary and speaker-attributed transcript as markdown or JSON.

Follow through on action items
- List the action items from your meetings, filtered to your own, one meeting, a status or a date range.
- Create an action item, reassign it, edit it, or mark it completed or dismissed.
- See the tickets linked to an item in GitHub, Linear, Jira, Asana, Trello, Todoist, Motion or Notion, and choose whether to close them when the item is done.
- Send an item or a whole meeting's items to your connected task tools.

Track topics and prepare
- Create topic trackers that watch phrases across meetings, and see where they came up with quotes.
- Read and edit a meeting's personal notes and shared agenda.

Recordings and calendar
- See which of your upcoming calendar events note1 is set to record.
- Send note1's recording bot to a meeting link, reschedule it, or call it off for one meeting or a series.
- Get a prefilled Google Meet or Teams calendar link with the note1 bot pre-invited. note1 does not create calendar events itself.
- Upload an existing audio or video recording to be transcribed and summarized.

See which Slack and task-tool integrations are connected and where tickets go. Team admins can also change their settings, connect them and disconnect them.

Your account and permissions
Sign in to note1 in your browser when you first use the plugin. Every action runs with your own note1 permissions, so private meetings stay private and results match what you see in the note1 dashboard. The plugin's instructions have ChatGPT confirm with you before it closes tickets, cancels a recording, deletes a tracker or disconnects an integration.
capabilities: Answer questions about your meetings with cited sources
Search meetings by keyword and meaning
Show who spoke most, questions asked and topics covered
Read meeting summaries, sections and participants
List your open action items from meetings
Create, edit, reassign and complete action items
Show and close the tickets linked to action items
Send action items to GitHub, Linear, Jira and other tools
Create and manage topic trackers across meetings
Read and edit meeting notes and shared agendas
Show which calendar events note1 is recording
Schedule, reschedule or cancel note1's recording bot
Create a calendar link with the note1 bot pre-invited
Upload an existing recording for a summary
Show integrations; let team admins change them
defaultPrompt: What did we decide about pricing in last week's meetings?
What are my open action items from this week's meetings?
Which of my meetings tomorrow are being recorded?

positive.description: Asks what was decided about a topic across recent meetings.
positive.prompt: What did we decide about pricing in last week's meetings?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the user's meetings in analysis mode and answers with the meeting titles, dates and timestamps it is based on.

positive.description: Lists the user's open action items and completes one of them.
positive.prompt: What are my open action items? Mark the deck one as done.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's open action items, then marks the matching item completed and reports any linked tickets that wait for a decision.

positive.description: Asks for speaker talk-time and unanswered questions in one meeting.
positive.prompt: Who spoke the most in yesterday's standup, and which questions went unanswered?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds yesterday's standup, then reads its speaker talk-time and questions from the meeting insights instead of the transcript.

positive.description: Asks which upcoming calendar events are being recorded.
positive.prompt: Which of my meetings tomorrow are being recorded?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists tomorrow's calendar events with their per-event recording status.

positive.description: Asks to watch a phrase across meetings with a topic tracker.
positive.prompt: Start tracking mentions of pricing across our meetings.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks existing trackers, then creates a personal topic tracker named for pricing with matching phrases.

negative.description: Weather question unrelated to meetings. The note1 plugin is not invoked.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Berlin tomorrow?

negative.description: Creative writing request that needs no meeting data. The note1 plugin is not invoked.
negative.prompt: Write me a poem about autumn.

negative.description: Travel booking request; note1 does not book travel. The note1 plugin is not invoked.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Lisbon next Friday.

commerce.description: No purchases. Plan limits are described only informationally.

publication.release_notes: Initial ChatGPT plugin release: 32 tools for meetings, action items, notes, trackers, integrations and recordings.
